summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe around tariff, trade-enforcement, testing, inspection, certification, customs-data, and traceability services. The cleanest US-listed direct exposures found in this pass are UL Solutions for product testing/certification, Descartes Systems for customs/regulatory compliance software and trade intelligence, Expeditors for customs brokerage/compliance workflow, and S&P Global as a reference-scale trade-data provider via Panjiva. The strongest underfollowed lane candidate is Descartes because tariff complexity can translate into recurring software, screening, filing, and trade-data demand rather than one-time freight volume. Expanded the node around tariff and trade-enforcement compliance into a small US-listed universe focused on customs/regulatory software, TIC/product certification, and specialized advisory capacity. The strongest direct public-market fit found in this pass is Descartes Systems Group because customs/regulatory compliance and global trade intelligence are core product lines. UL Solutions is the cleanest US-listed TIC/product-certification reference name, but its direct tariff sensitivity is more indirect. FTI Consulting and CBIZ are underfollowed advisory-capacity candidates with explicit tariff/customs offerings, but exposure is likely small relative to total revenue and needs segment-level verification. Layer 1B expands the universe around second-order beneficiaries of tariff regimes, domestic-content rules, forced-labor checks, export controls, customs complexity, and supply-chain visibility mandates.
